summary: Implemented an API-enforced dynamic administrative RBAC engine. It uses a closed stable capability catalog, strict custom and View Only roles, bootstrap-guard-only full access, active-role permission unions, current Admin account-state checks, optimistic role mutation, bounded versioned administrator assignments, explicit response projections, and server-derived availableActions. Activated only the three role routes already present in the endpoint blueprint; administrator CRUD and assignment-route integration remain owned by backend_121.

verification.notes: Executed with Node v22.18.0; the repository-declared Node 24 baseline remains a known environment gap.
Installed 199 packages from the lockfile and audited 205 packages with zero vulnerabilities; the expected Node engine warning is recorded separately.
